title.zh-TW: Opus 5 上線成為預設，快速模式跟著換人
title.en: Opus 5 lands as the default, and fast mode moves with it

body.zh-TW: 新的 Claude Opus 5 接手成為預設的 Opus 模型，代號是 `claude-opus-5`。它一次能讀進一百萬 context（模型一次記得住的文字量），快速模式的計價是每百萬文字單位進 10 美元、出 50 美元。連帶兩件事也跟著調整：`/fast` 這個快速模式不再適用 Opus 4.7，改成套用在 Opus 5 和 Opus 4.8 上；`claude-api` 這份技能檔的預設模型也換成 Opus 5，並附上從 Opus 4.8 搬過來的做法。像學校換了新版教科書，開學領到的自動就是新版；但你書單上如果寫死舊版書號，訂起來就會撲空。你什麼都不用改就會用到新模型，只有手邊寫死舊模型代號的腳本，得回頭檢查。
body.en: Claude Opus 5 (`claude-opus-5`) takes over as the default Opus model, with a 1M context window and fast-mode pricing of $10 in and $50 out per million tokens. Two things move with it: `/fast` no longer covers Opus 4.7 and now applies to Opus 5 and Opus 4.8, and the `claude-api` skill defaults to Opus 5 with a documented path over from Opus 4.8. A school switching to a new edition of a textbook works the same way: what you are handed at the start of term is the new one, but a reading list with the old ISBN written into it will order nothing. You get the new model without changing anything; only scripts with an older model id hard-coded need a second look.

title.zh-TW: `/model` 選單的三個看走眼，一次修好
title.en: Three ways the `/model` picker misled you, now fixed

body.zh-TW: 挑模型是很快的動作，你掃一眼就按下去，所以清單寫錯特別傷。這版修掉三處：合併後的 Opus 那一列只寫「Opus」，看不出它其實是「Opus (1M context)」；Fable 那一列對明明已包含它的方案顯示「需要用量點數」，原因是舊的暫存把那句標籤烙在裡面沒更新；還有高亮，以前會標到清單中不特定的一段，現在只標最新那個模型的名字，你一眼就知道新的是哪個。像餐廳菜單把價格印錯又把招牌菜標在別道菜旁邊——菜沒問題，是菜單在誤導人。
body.en: Picking a model is a glance-and-click action, which is exactly why a wrong list hurts. Three fixes here: the merged Opus row read plain "Opus" instead of "Opus (1M context)"; the Fable row claimed "Requires usage credits" on plans that already include it, because a stale cache had baked that label in; and the highlight, which used to mark an arbitrary subset of the list, now marks only the newest model's name so you can see at a glance which release is new. A menu with the wrong prices and the chef's-special marker next to the wrong dish — the kitchen is fine, the menu is misleading you.

title.zh-TW: 子代理可以再叫子代理，最多疊三層
title.en: Subagents can now spawn subagents, three layers deep

body.zh-TW: 派一個助手去做事，它做到一半發現該再找兩個人分頭查——以前它做不到，只能自己吞下去。現在子代理預設可以往下再開子代理，最多疊到三層（原本只有一層）。不想要這種層層轉包，在環境變數設 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1` 就關掉。同時，第二層以下開出來的子代理不再是黑箱：只要加上 `--forward-subagent-text`，它們的輸出會出現在 stream-json 裡，並掛在當初叫出它的那個代理底下，看得出誰是誰派的。像工班分包，以前只准分一層，現在准到三層，但每一層是誰發包的都要登記在同一張表上。
body.en: You send one assistant off to do a job; halfway through it realises the work should be split between two more people — and until now it could not do that, it had to swallow the whole thing itself. Subagents can now spawn their own subagents, three levels deep by default, up from one. If you would rather not have work subcontracted down a chain, set `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1` to switch nesting off. The deeper ones are no longer a black box either: with `--forward-subagent-text`, subagents spawned at depth two and below show up in stream-json, keyed to the agent `tool_use` id that spawned them, so you can see who dispatched whom. Building trades subcontract the same way — one level used to be the limit, three is now allowed, and every level is logged against whoever hired it.

items.original:

title.zh-TW: 動態工作流程預設收斂到 15 個代理以內，可自己改
title.en: Dynamic workflows now aim for under 15 agents by default

body.zh-TW:
交給系統自動編排的工作流程，以前沒有規模上的建議，一個任務可能被拆成幾十個代理各跑各的，你既看不出全貌也算不出成本。現在預設是中等規模，也就是「盡量少於 15 個代理」，這只是建議不是硬限制。想換規模有兩條路。臨時改：在 `/config` 裡選 Dynamic workflow size，可以挑別的大小或不設限。想固定下來：在設定檔加一行 `workflowSizeGuideline`，這樣任何設定檔都能指定，例如

```
{"workflowSizeGuideline": "medium"}
```

設定檔一旦寫了這個鍵，`/config` 裡那一列就會自動隱藏，避免兩邊講不一樣的話。另外，工作流程跑起來時，狀態列會直接顯示目前用的是哪個規模，旁邊附上去 `/config` 改的指路。像旅行團有沒有規定團員人數上限——沒規定不代表比較自由，只是你到了現場才知道來了幾個人。
body.en:
Workflows the system plans for you had no size guidance, so one task could fan out into dozens of agents running in parallel, leaving you unable to see the shape of it or estimate the cost. The default is now a medium guideline — aim for fewer than 15 agents — and it is advisory, not a hard cap. There are two ways to change it. Ad hoc: pick Dynamic workflow size in `/config` for another size or unrestricted. Permanently: set `workflowSizeGuideline` in any settings file, for example

```
{"workflowSizeGuideline": "medium"}
```

While a settings file specifies that key, the `/config` row hides itself so the two cannot disagree. A running workflow also shows the current size in its status line, with a pointer to `/config` if you want to change it. Think of a tour with no stated cap on group size: the absence of a limit is not freedom, it just means you find out how many people showed up when you get there.

items.original:
Added the `workflowSizeGuideline` settings key so the advisory Dynamic workflow size guideline can be set from any settings file; the `/config` row is hidden while one does
Changed dynamic workflows to default to a medium size guideline (aim for fewer than 15 agents); pick another size or unrestricted with Dynamic workflow size in `/config`
Added the current default workflow size to the running-workflow status line, with a pointer to `/config` for changing it

title.zh-TW: 沙箱連外網，可以設成直接擋掉不再問你
title.en: Sandboxed commands can now block unlisted hosts silently

body.zh-TW:
在沙箱（把指令關在受限環境裡跑的隔離區）裡執行的指令想連某個網站，而那個網站不在你的允許清單上時，以前會跳出來問你要不要放行。跑自動化的場合沒人在鍵盤前，這一問就是整條流程停住。新的 `sandbox.network.strictAllowlist` 讓你選擇直接拒絕、連問都不問。要開的話，在設定檔加上這段：

```
{"sandbox": {"network": {"strictAllowlist": true}}}
```

這裡的巢狀寫法是「一層包一層」：`sandbox` 裡有 `network`，`network` 裡才是 `strictAllowlist`。像大樓門禁改成沒登記就是進不來，警衛不再打電話上樓問你要不要放行——訪客會吃閉門羹，但半夜也不會有人被吵醒。
body.en:
When a command running inside the sandbox — the restricted area commands are confined to — tries to reach a host that is not on your allowlist, you used to get a prompt asking whether to permit it. In an automated run there is nobody at the keyboard, so that prompt is where the whole pipeline stops. The new `sandbox.network.strictAllowlist` setting lets you deny outright, without asking. To turn it on, add this to a settings file:

```
{"sandbox": {"network": {"strictAllowlist": true}}}
```

The nesting reads as one box inside another: `sandbox` contains `network`, and `network` contains `strictAllowlist`. It is a building switching to strict door policy — unregistered visitors simply do not get in, and the guard stops phoning upstairs to ask. Some visitors are turned away, but nobody gets woken at three in the morning.

items.original: Added `sandbox.network.strictAllowlist` setting to deny non-allowlisted hosts for sandboxed commands without prompting

title.zh-TW: 外部工具接不上時，終於說得出哪裡出錯
title.en: When an MCP server fails, you finally hear why

body.zh-TW: MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 接上外部工具的協定）伺服器連不上，以前只知道失敗，不知道為什麼。這版三處補上線索。`claude mcp list` 和 `/mcp` 現在會附上 HTTP 狀態碼和錯誤內容，是憑證過期還是位址打錯，一看就分得出來；設定值前後藏著看不見的空白時，也會出聲警告——那種錯最折磨人，因為畫面上看起來完全正常。沒有畫面的 stream-json 啟動事件則多了 `mcp_server_errors`，把 `--mcp-config` 裡因為驗證不通過而被略過的項目列出來，終端機執行時也會在開頭印警告。像寄信被退回，以前只收到一張「無法投遞」，現在退件單上寫了地址哪一行有問題。
body.en: When an MCP server would not connect, you knew it had failed and nothing more. Three additions here. `claude mcp list` and `/mcp` now report the HTTP status and error text, so an expired credential looks different from a mistyped address; and config values with hidden leading or trailing whitespace now raise a warning — the most maddening class of error, because the screen looks entirely correct. The headless stream-json init event gained `mcp_server_errors`, listing the `--mcp-config` entries that config validation skipped, and terminal runs print a startup warning too. A returned letter used to come back stamped only "undeliverable"; now the slip tells you which line of the address is wrong.

items.original:
Added `mcp_server_errors` to the headless stream-json init event, listing `--mcp-config` entries skipped by config validation; terminal runs print a startup warning
Added HTTP status and error text to `claude mcp list` and `/mcp` when a server fails to connect, and a warning for MCP config values with hidden leading or trailing whitespace

title.zh-TW: 公司派下來的外部工具清單，不再被本機設定改寫
title.en: Managed MCP lists stop reading variables from the settings file

body.zh-TW: 公司統一派發的 MCP 允許與拒絕清單，裡面常寫 `${VAR}` 這種變數，等實際執行時再換成真正的值。問題是以前它從設定檔裡的環境變數區塊取值——而設定檔就在使用者手上，等於管理者訂的規則，可以被本機的一行設定改掉。現在改成從啟動時的環境和受管理設定自己的環境取值，設定檔那份不再參與。像醫院的用藥規定，以前各護理站自己抄一份貼在白板上，誰都擦得掉；現在改成每次掃碼直接讀系統裡的正本。
body.en: Centrally managed MCP allowlists and denylists often contain `${VAR}` entries that get substituted at run time. The catch was where the substitution read from: the env block of a settings file — a file that sits in the user's own hands, which meant a rule set by an administrator could be rewritten by one local line. Those entries now resolve from the startup environment and the managed-settings env instead, and the settings-file env no longer participates. Think of dosage rules in a hospital: they used to be copied onto a whiteboard at each nurses' station, where anyone could rub a figure out. Now they are scanned straight from the system's master copy each time.

items.original: Changed managed MCP allowlist/denylist `${VAR}` entries to resolve from the startup environment and managed-settings env instead of settings-file env

title.zh-TW: 聊到一半加資料夾，掛鉤跟著醒過來
title.en: Add a folder mid-conversation and a hook wakes up

body.zh-TW: 同一個工作階段聊到一半，才想起另一個資料夾也得一起看，於是你把它加了進來。新的 DirectoryAdded 掛鉤（特定事件發生時自動觸發的小程式）就在這一刻醒過來，向周邊工具發出通知。只要輸入 `/add-dir` 指令，或是透過 SDK 發出 `register_repo_root` 控制請求來註冊新目錄，Claude Code 就會自動觸發這個掛鉤，讓周邊工具第一時間掌握目錄變更。像展覽館在展覽進行中臨時加設新展位，廣播室與服務台隨即收到連線通知，周邊服務就能馬上配合跟上。
body.en: Halfway through a conversation you remember that another folder needs to be in scope, so you bring it in. The new `DirectoryAdded` hook wakes up at exactly that moment and notifies the tools around you. A new `DirectoryAdded` hook fires whenever a new working directory is registered mid-session — whether you type the `/add-dir` command or issue a `register_repo_root` control request via the SDK. Secondary tools learn right away that the folder list has changed. Think of an exhibition hall opening an extra booth mid-event: the moment the new space is registered, the information desk and public address system get an instant update so services can adjust without delay.

items.original: Added `DirectoryAdded` hook that fires after `/add-dir` or the SDK `register_repo_root` control request registers a new working directory mid-session

title.zh-TW: 複製、方向鍵、朗讀，三個按下去才發現的毛病
title.en: Three faults you only meet the moment you press a key

body.zh-TW: 這三個毛病都要等你手指按下去才會發現，所以特別磨人。首先是在 GNU screen 環境下劃選文字時，終端機不再印出一串 base64（將任意資料轉成純英數字串的編碼）字串，而是正常完成複製；其次是在 Vim 模式下的空白輸入列按左箭頭鍵（←），除了 INSERT 模式外，NORMAL 模式現在也能順利退回代理畫面；最後是螢幕閱讀器模式打字時只會朗讀剛輸入的字元，不會每按一下就重讀整行文字。像使用按鈕回饋錯亂的控制面板：劃選複製跳出無關字串、按返回鍵像卡住按不動、打字時語音重讀整行，都是按下去那一刻的動作與回饋對不上。
body.en: All three of these only show up at the instant your finger presses a key, which is what makes them grating. Text highlighted inside GNU screen now copies properly instead of dumping raw base64 strings into your terminal. Pressing the left arrow (←) on an empty prompt in Vim mode now returns to the agent view from NORMAL mode as well as INSERT mode. Finally, screen-reader mode echoes only the single typed character per keystroke rather than re-reading the entire input line. Like using a control panel with miswired button feedback: selecting text prints extra code, pressing back feels stuck, and typing echoes the entire line — every action produces the wrong immediate response.

items.original:
Fixed copy-on-select inside GNU screen printing base64 into the terminal instead of copying the selection
Fixed Vim mode: pressing ← on an empty prompt now returns to the agent view from NORMAL mode, not just INSERT
Fixed screen-reader mode rewriting the entire input line on every keystroke instead of echoing only the typed character

title.zh-TW: 遙控端不再顯示過期狀態，出錯也說得出是哪個設定
title.en: No more stale remote status, and errors that name the setting

body.zh-TW: 隔著一台裝置操作，最怕畫面上寫的跟實際狀況對不上。這版把遠端控制（Remote Control）的三處落差補起來。首先修復了遠端控制用戶端在切換模型、斷線重連或組織權限檢查失敗後，快速模式仍殘留舊狀態的問題；其次，當跳出「遠端控制僅支援 api.anthropic.com」的錯誤時，錯誤訊息會直接點名是哪一個設定項導致衝突；最後，執行 `claude --teleport` 遇到手邊 checkout 的專案庫與工作階段不一致時，現在會明確印出你目前 checkout 指向的是哪一個專案庫。像遠端駕駛艙的儀表板，開關狀態即時同步、故障時精準亮起對應燈號，定位不符時也會清楚顯示你實際停在哪個車庫。
body.en: Operating something through another device, the thing you dread is the screen disagreeing with reality. Three such gaps in Remote Control are closed here. Remote Control clients no longer hold onto a stale fast-mode status after switching models, reconnecting, or failing an organization check. When the error "Remote Control is only available via api.anthropic.com" appears, the diagnostic text now explicitly names the specific setting that triggered it. Finally, running `claude --teleport` when your current checkout repository differs from the session's repository now prints which repository your current checkout actually points to. Like a remote cockpit dashboard: switch toggles update in real time, error lights pinpoint the exact faulty breaker, and location mismatches show the actual hanger where your vessel is parked.

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control clients keeping a stale fast-mode status after a model switch, reconnect, or failed org check
Improved the "Remote Control is only available via api.anthropic.com" error to name the specific setting that caused it
Improved `claude --teleport` to show which repo your current checkout points at when it doesn't match the session's repo

title.zh-TW: 無效 Git Bash 路徑改發警告，中途斷線保留已產出回答
title.en: Invalid Git Bash paths now raise warnings, and mid-stream errors preserve output

body.zh-TW: 設定檔填錯與中途網路中斷這兩類突發狀況，現在都不會再一秒蒸發你的作業結果。這版做了兩項重要修復：在 Windows 上如果將 `CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH` 環境變數指向非 bash 或 sh 的執行檔，以前會直接崩潰或硬當成 bash 執行，現在改為印出警告並自動忽略該無效路徑；另外，使用 `claude -p`（無畫面直接印出文字的執行模式）時，若在生成答案中途遇到 API 網路錯誤而中斷，Claude Code 不會再把已經產出的前半段回答全部丟掉，而是完整保留並印出來。像車載導航系統：填錯無效路徑時跳出警告並繼續走主幹道，就算中途訊號中斷，也完好保留已下載的前半段路線。
body.en: Mistyped path settings and mid-stream network drops will no longer wipe out your progress in an instant. Two essential fixes are included: on Windows, if `CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH` points to a file that is not a bash or sh binary, it no longer crashes or gets misused as bash, but instead ignores the invalid path with a warning. Furthermore, when running `claude -p` (the headless mode that prints text output), if a turn dies due to a mid-stream API network error, Claude Code no longer discards the answer already generated, but preserves and prints it completely. Think of a car navigation system: it issues a warning about an invalid shortcut while keeping you on the main highway, and even if signal drops mid-trip, it preserves the route segment already downloaded.

items.original:
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH` on Windows exiting or being used as bash when the path isn't a bash/sh binary; it's now ignored with a warning
Fixed `claude -p` text output dropping the answer already produced when a turn dies on a mid-stream API error

entries: Changed `/code-review` to run as a background subagent, so review work no longer fills your conversation and keeps stacked slash commands as its review target
Added screen-reader announcements of deleted text for word and line deletions (`Option+Delete`, `Ctrl+W`, `Cmd+Backspace`, `Ctrl+U`, `Ctrl+K`) in `--ax-screen-reader` mode

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查留在背景，結果更貼近你的分支
title.en: Code reviews move to the background and stay on target

body.zh-TW: 你請 Claude 檢查一串改動，還想繼續問別的事時，`/code-review` 現在會交給背景 subagent（在旁邊獨立做事的小幫手）處理，不再把整個對話塞滿；連著輸入的 slash commands 也仍會以這次審查為目標。`/ultrareview` 可接受「檢查我的登入改動」這種說法：它會審查目前分支，並把這句當成結果備註。非互動執行 `/code-review ultra` 也會確實啟動雲端審查，而非悄悄改做本機審查；參數不對時，Claude 會拿到可修正的錯誤訊息。像把文件送去後台校稿，你仍能在前台寫下一封信，校稿員也知道該看哪一份。

Chained slash commands still point at that review. `/ultrareview` now accepts wording such as “review my auth changes”: it reviews the current branch and attaches those words as a note. In non-interactive runs, `/code-review ultra` now truly starts a cloud review instead of silently falling back to a local one, and bad arguments return useful feedback. It is like sending a document to an editor while you keep writing at your desk; the editor still knows which document to read.

title.zh-TW: 螢幕閱讀器能跟上刪字與游標

At the end of the input, VoiceOver reports a typed space instead of wrongly saying “new line.” In the plugin and settings panels, terminal focus now follows the row selected with arrow keys, so screen readers and magnifiers can locate it. It is like having someone read a draft aloud while pointing to the words you just erased and the line you are currently reading.

The pasted line breaks are now preserved. Pressing Left Arrow immediately after editing no longer silently discards the whole conversation; Claude asks for confirmation first. If you enter agent view, the screen for work running in the background, Esc returns you to the conversation it backgrounded. It is like pasted paragraphs staying as paragraphs, with someone asking before an accidental elbow bump throws your letter away.

title.zh-TW: MCP 連不上時，終於看得到原因

MCP, the Model Context Protocol for connecting AI to outside tools, also warns when a configuration value has invisible whitespace at its beginning or end; those spaces can break an otherwise identical URL or key. The startup notice about MCP servers needing authentication no longer counts claude.ai connectors that are not connected there. It is like support telling you whether a phone number is wrong or busy, then removing ghost contacts from the list.

title.zh-TW: Windows 路徑與長選取文字不再亂碼
title.en: Windows paths and long selections no longer become garbled

body.zh-TW: Windows 使用者若要讓工具讀取 `C:\Users\unicorn` 這類路徑，`\u` 開頭的片段以前可能被誤當成 Unicode 編碼，變成中日韓字，於是檔案像被改了地址般找不到；現在會保留原路徑。IDE 裡選了一大段文字，若內容剛好在 emoji 中間被截斷，也不再產生亂碼。另有工具執行器出錯卻被悄悄吞掉的情形也已修正。這像郵差終於照信封地址送件，不會把 `\u` 當成暗號改寫，信封破到一半時也會說清楚，而不是裝作沒收到。
body.en: For Windows users, a path such as `C:\Users\unicorn` could have its `\u` segment mistaken for Unicode encoding and turned into CJK characters, making the file unreachable as if its address had changed. The original path is now kept intact. A long selection from an IDE also no longer becomes mojibake when it is cut in the middle of an emoji, and a tool-executor error is no longer silently lost. It is like a postal worker finally delivering to the address written on the envelope, rather than treating `\u` as a secret code and pretending a torn envelope never arrived.

title.zh-TW: 對話紀錄與背景工作少出現幽靈狀態
title.en: Conversation history and background work lose their ghost states

body.zh-TW: 整理過長對話後查看 `/context`，token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量不再顯示整理前的舊數字。工具中斷後，也不會亂留「使用者中斷請求」或缺了另一半的 `tool_use` 紀錄；prompt history 寫入碰撞或失敗時，歷史紀錄不再容易漏掉或重複。遇到 context overflow（對話塞超過可容納的量）又有很大的 thinking budget 時，重試不會一直重送同一個註定失敗的請求。背景化與 headless／SDK 的 fork session，整理後也保得住來源關係；壞掉的 delta attachment 不再讓續接對話每回合失敗。像一本帳本不再重複記帳、掉頁，換了書封後仍看得出每張收據從哪裡來。
body.en: After compacting a long conversation, `/context` no longer reports the old pre-compaction token count, the text units AI processes and bills for. Interrupted tools no longer leave a false “Request interrupted by user” message or half a `tool_use` record, and prompt history is less likely to lose or duplicate entries when writes collide or fail. A context-overflow retry with a large thinking budget stops resending the same doomed request. Backgrounded and headless or SDK fork sessions also retain their lineage after compaction, while malformed delta attachments no longer doom every resumed turn. It is like an account book that stops duplicating or losing entries and still shows where each receipt came from after rebinding.

title.zh-TW: 雲端模型計費、PR 與 AWS 設定更可靠
title.en: Cloud model billing, PRs, and AWS setup become more reliable

body.zh-TW: 透過 Bedrock 使用模型時，gateway 花費計量現在會依你設定的模型費率計算 application-inference-profile ARN 與其他對應到上游模型的 ID，不會因識別碼不同而算錯價。剛建立或連結 pull request（PR，請求把一組程式改動併入專案的單據）就結束 session，也較不會遺失 PR 事件。Bedrock 設定精靈對分區 AWS 區域的 assume-role profile（暫時借用另一個 AWS 身分的設定），或只能走 proxy 的網路，能正確驗證。系統時鐘被調整後，回合耗時也不會罕見地變負數或失真。就像計程車改按可靠的里程表計價，收據、身分證明與行車時間都不會因儀表跳動而弄錯。
body.en: When using models through Bedrock, gateway spend metering now charges application-inference-profile ARNs and other IDs mapped to an upstream model at the configured model’s rate, rather than pricing them incorrectly because the identifier differs. Pull-request events are less likely to vanish if a session ends right after creating or linking a PR, a request to merge a set of code changes. The Bedrock setup wizard can also verify assume-role profiles in partitioned AWS regions and proxy-only networks. Turn durations no longer rarely become negative or wrong after a system clock change. It is like a taxi switching to a dependable meter, so fares, receipts, identity checks, and trip time do not drift when the dashboard clock jumps.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式少打擾，信任範圍更清楚
title.en: Auto mode interrupts less and makes trust boundaries clearer

body.zh-TW: 自動模式遇到危險的 `rm`、背景 `&` 或可疑 Windows 路徑時，不會一律跳出權限視窗；會交由 auto-mode classifier（判斷是否安全的自動分類器）決定。plan mode 裡，靜態分析器無法證明是唯讀的 Bash 指令，也同樣交給它判斷，少掉不必要的打斷。IDE 互動的 sandbox（把程式限制在安全範圍的隔間）指令限制也加強了。信任對話框會明說授權涵蓋哪個 repository root（專案最外層資料夾），agent frontmatter 的 hook（特定事件觸發的小程式）則必須放在已接受工作區信任的資料夾。伺服器管理設定中的無害功能與成本開關，也不再每次都要求批准。這像門禁把一般訪客、危險包裹和哪棟樓的通行證分清楚。
body.en: Auto mode no longer opens a permission dialog for every dangerous `rm`, background `&`, or suspicious Windows path; its safety classifier decides instead. In plan mode, Bash commands the static analyzer cannot prove read-only go to that classifier too, reducing needless interruptions. Sandbox restrictions, the boundaries that confine a program, are stronger for IDE interactions. Trust dialogs now name the repository root they cover, while hooks, small programs triggered by events, in agent frontmatter require the agent file’s own folder to be trusted. Benign feature and cost toggles in server-managed settings no longer request approval every time. It is like an entry desk that distinguishes an ordinary visitor, a dangerous parcel, and which building a pass actually opens.

title.zh-TW: 深度研究改由你開啟，換模型會通知
title.en: You now start deep research, and model switches announce themselves

body.zh-TW: 你想快速問一個小問題時，Claude 不會自行啟動 `/deep-research` 把流程拉長；只有你手動輸入這個指令才會開始。相反地，若你透過 `/config model=<x>` 或 Remote Control 換模型，fast mode（優先加快回應的模式）因此改變時，現在會有公告，避免你以為速度設定還和剛才一樣。這像咖啡店不會擅自把你的外帶咖啡升級成慢工手沖，但換了吧台與出杯速度，會把牌子翻出來讓你知道。
body.en: When you want a quick answer, Claude no longer starts `/deep-research` on its own and stretches the process out; it begins only when you invoke the command manually. Conversely, if switching models through `/config model=<x>` or Remote Control changes fast mode, the mode that prioritizes quicker responses, Claude now announces that change. You no longer have to assume the speed setting is what it was a moment ago. It is like a coffee shop not upgrading your takeaway order to a slow hand brew without asking, while clearly flipping a sign if the bar and serving speed change.

title.zh-TW: Agent 與 skill 設定更寬容，也避開名稱撞車
title.en: Agent and skill settings accept more forms and avoid name clashes

body.zh-TW: 自己寫 agent 或 skill 的 Markdown 設定時，agent 名稱若含 `:`，現在會直接拒絕，因為這個符號保留給 plugin namespacing（用名稱前綴區分外掛來源的規則），可避免日後撞名。skill 的 frontmatter（檔案最上方的設定區）若填 `context: fork`，預設會在背景執行；想留在前台，可加 `background: false`。布林值也不必只能寫 `true`／`false`：不分大小寫的 `yes`、`no`、`on`、`off`、`1`、`0` 都接受。像替社區信箱訂規格：冒號留給地址分區，寄件方式有清楚預設，而「開／關」也聽得懂多種自然說法。
body.en: When writing Markdown settings for an agent or skill, an agent name containing `:` is now rejected because that character is reserved for plugin namespacing, the prefix system that distinguishes plugin sources. This prevents future name collisions. A skill frontmatter, the settings block at the top of the file, with `context: fork` now runs in the background by default; add `background: false` to keep it in front. Boolean values no longer need to be only `true` or `false`: case-insensitive `yes`, `no`, `on`, `off`, `1`, and `0` work too. It is like setting rules for community mailboxes: colons reserve address zones, delivery has a clear default, and several natural ways of saying on or off are understood.

title.zh-TW: 深層資料夾搬動不再讓介面當掉
title.en: Moving deep folder trees no longer crashes the interface

body.zh-TW: 專案裡有一層又一層的被監看資料夾時，整棵目錄樹被刪除或搬走，Claude 以前可能因呼叫層數太深而崩潰，畫面要繪製同樣深的 UI 樹也會出問題；現在已修正。這對一般專案不會多出新按鈕，卻讓大型、巢狀很深的專案整理資料夾時少一次突然斷線。像搬走一整排層層疊起的收納箱，搬運員不再數到最底層就昏倒，展示架也不會在畫到最深一格時垮掉。
body.en: In a project with watched folders nested many layers deep, deleting or moving the whole directory tree could make Claude crash from excessive call depth. Rendering an equally deep UI tree could fail too. Both cases are fixed. This adds no new button for an ordinary project, but it makes reorganizing a large, deeply nested one less likely to end in a sudden failure. It is like moving a tower of stacked storage boxes without the mover fainting at the bottom layer or the display rack collapsing at its deepest shelf.

Added a cap on concurrently-running subagents (default 20, override with `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS`) so one message can't fan out unbounded background agents
Changed subagents to no longer spawn nested subagents by default; set `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` to allow deeper nesting
Fixed `--max-budget-usd` not stopping background subagents: once the cap is reached, new spawns are denied and running background agents are halted

title.zh-TW: 打幾個字母，表情符號就自己送上門
title.en: Type a few letters and the emoji comes to you

body.zh-TW:
你正在寫提示，想加一顆愛心時，不必停下來翻表情符號鍵盤。現在輸入完整的 `:heart:`，Claude Code 就會插入 ❤️；只打到 `:hea`，畫面也會列出候選。這項表情符號短碼（用冒號包住名稱來代表一個符號的簡寫）就像手機的預測輸入：先給幾個字母，它便把可能要用的圖案送到手邊，寫句子的節奏不會被打斷。若候選清單反而讓你分心，打開個人設定檔 `~/.claude/settings.json`，在最外層加入下面這一行即可關閉：

```json
{"emojiCompletionEnabled": false}
```

若檔案裡已有其他設定，只需在同一對大括號內加入 `"emojiCompletionEnabled": false`，並用逗號和前一項隔開。
body.en:
Want a heart in the prompt you are writing? You no longer need to stop and hunt through an emoji picker. Type the complete shortcode `:heart:` and Claude Code inserts ❤️; type only `:hea` and it shows suggestions. A shortcode is a symbol name wrapped in colons, and it works like predictive text on a phone: offer a few letters and the likely emoji comes to you without breaking your writing rhythm. If the suggestion list is distracting, open your personal settings file at `~/.claude/settings.json` and add this top-level setting:

```json
{"emojiCompletionEnabled": false}
```

If that file already contains other settings, add `"emojiCompletionEnabled": false` inside the same outer braces and separate it from the previous entry with a comma.

items.original: Added emoji shortcode autocomplete in the prompt input: type `:heart:` to insert ❤️, or `:hea` for suggestions — disable with the `emojiCompletionEnabled` setting

title.zh-TW: 對話紀錄出狀況，不再悄悄消失
title.en: Transcript trouble no longer stays silent

body.zh-TW: 辛苦聊完一段工作，最怕關掉才發現紀錄根本沒存。現在 transcript（對話逐字紀錄）因磁碟滿了寫不進去，或 session（一次持續工作的對話）因承接的環境變數而沒有儲存時，Claude Code 會先警告你。舊紀錄裡就算有格式壞掉的附件，`--resume`、`--continue` 與 `/resume` 也不會因此整個失敗；接回剛啟動的背景對話時，預覽和輸入框間會保留一行空隙，不會突然跳動。像收據夾終於會在紙快塞不下時提醒你，也不會因一張破收據讓整本帳都打不開。
body.en: After a long working conversation, discovering that nothing was saved is miserable. Claude Code now warns you if a transcript cannot be written, such as when the disk is full, or if session saving is disabled by an inherited environment variable. A malformed attachment in an old transcript no longer breaks `--resume`, `--continue`, or `/resume`, and attaching to a starting background session no longer makes the preview jump against the input. Think of a receipt folder that warns when it is full and does not make the whole ledger unreadable because one receipt is torn.

items.original:
Added warnings when transcript writes are failing (e.g. disk full) or when session saving is off due to an inherited environment variable, instead of losing transcripts silently
Fixed `--resume`/`--continue` and `/resume` failing with a TypeError when a transcript has a malformed attachment entry
Fixed the transcript preview sitting flush against the input area when attaching to a starting background session; it now leaves the same one-line gap as the live layout, so the transcript no longer shifts when the session takes over

title.zh-TW: 長工作階段不再吃光記憶體、卡在整理關卡
title.en: Long sessions stop hoarding memory and missing their cleanup

body.zh-TW: 工具回傳很長的結果時，畫面雖只留摘要，記憶體卻曾偷偷抱著完整原文直到工作階段結束。這次修掉 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具輸出被截短後仍佔滿記憶體的問題。Claude Opus 4.8 在 Bedrock 上的自動壓縮也終於會觸發，超過上限時 `/compact` 不再失敗；而 `CLAUDE.md` 或 `SKILL.md` 的 paths 設定塞進太多大括號，也不會讓 CLI（命令列介面）啟動時耗盡記憶體或卡死。像收納員只留下需要看的摘要，不再把整車舊紙箱偷偷堆在後房。
body.en: A tool can return a huge result while the screen shows only a shortened version; previously, the full result could still sit in memory until the session ended. This fixes that MCP (Model Context Protocol, the standard for connecting AI to external tools) memory leak. Auto-compact now fires for Claude Opus 4.8 on Bedrock, `/compact` works past the limit, and excessive brace groups in `CLAUDE.md` or `SKILL.md` paths no longer freeze or exhaust the CLI at startup. It is like a clerk keeping the summary you need instead of secretly piling the whole truckload of boxes in the back room.

items.original:
Fixed a memory leak where truncated MCP tool outputs kept the full untruncated result in memory for the rest of the session
Fixed auto-compact never triggering for Claude Opus 4.8 on Bedrock and `/compact` failing once over the limit
Fixed a `CLAUDE.md` or `SKILL.md` paths frontmatter value with many brace groups OOM-killing or stalling the CLI at startup — brace expansion is now budget-bounded

title.zh-TW: 更新失手會復原，背景命令也叫得停
title.en: Failed updates recover, and background commands can be stopped

body.zh-TW: Windows 更新若半路失敗，最糟曾會把 `claude.exe` 一起弄丟；現在失敗時會自動放回保留的執行檔，Claude 不會憑空消失。另一個讓人無力的情況是把 session（一次持續工作的對話）送到背景後，背景 shell（執行命令的程式）有時再也停不下來，尤其 Windows 或電腦很忙時更明顯。這版把它修好，無論用 `/background`、左箭頭送進背景，或對話正結束，都能正常停止。這就像工廠換新機器時把舊機留在旁邊備援；若要停工，也終於能關掉仍在背景運轉的機器。
body.en: A failed Windows update could once leave you without `claude.exe`; now it automatically restores the preserved executable instead of making Claude vanish. Another frustrating case was a background shell that sometimes could not be stopped after a session was sent to the background, especially on Windows or a heavily loaded computer. This is fixed whether you use `/background`, the left arrow, or the session is exiting. It is like replacing a factory machine while keeping the old one nearby as a backup, then being able to shut down the machine still running in the back room.

items.original:
Fixed Windows auto-update failures that could leave `claude.exe` missing; failed updates now restore the preserved executable automatically
Fixed background shells sometimes becoming impossible to stop after a session is sent to the background (`/background` or `←`) or when the session exits on a heavily loaded machine, most visible on Windows

title.zh-TW: 背景對話不會沿捷徑跑出工作區
title.en: Background sessions cannot slip out through a shortcut

body.zh-TW: 把背景 session（一次持續工作的對話）關在指定工作區，本來就該像把人留在同一間辦公室；但工作資料夾若經過 symlink（符號連結，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），先前路徑沒有被認成真正位置，對話可能因此逃出 workspace folder（工作區資料夾）。現在背景隔離會先辨認捷徑最後通往哪裡，再套用邊界，避免工作跑到不該碰的資料夾。這是安全修復，不是新增限制：你照常從捷徑開工作，但門禁終於看得懂它通往哪一扇門。
body.en: A background session should stay inside its assigned workspace, like a worker staying in the right office. But if its working directory was reached through a symlink (a shortcut file pointing elsewhere), the path was not converted to its real location and the session could escape its workspace folder. Background isolation now resolves that shortcut first, then applies the boundary. This is a security fix, not a new restriction: you can still open work through a shortcut, but the access gate now knows which door it actually reaches.

items.original: Fixed background session isolation not canonicalizing symlinked working directories, which could let sessions escape their workspace folder

title.zh-TW: 公司網路設定終於真的跟著 Claude Desktop 走
title.en: Corporate network rules finally reach Claude Desktop

body.zh-TW: 在公司網路裡能開網頁，不代表 Claude Desktop 就連得出去：mTLS、TLS 驗證、OAuth 範圍與 proxy（代理伺服器，代替你轉送網路連線的中繼站）設定曾被它忽略。現在這些企業設定會在 Desktop session（一次持續工作的對話）生效。受管理的 `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` 也能真正管住所有 telemetry（遙測資料，程式送出的運作紀錄）訊號，較低層級的個別設定不能再把資料改送到別處。像總公司替每輛車規劃好路線與回報站，現在所有車都會照著走，不會有一輛私自繞路。
body.en: Being able to open a website on a corporate network did not always mean Claude Desktop could connect: it was ignoring mTLS, TLS verification, OAuth scopes, and proxy settings. Those corporate settings now apply to Desktop sessions. A managed `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` also truly governs every telemetry signal, so lower-scope, signal-specific overrides cannot redirect data elsewhere. It is like headquarters setting the route and reporting depot for every vehicle; now every one follows it rather than one quietly taking a detour.

items.original:
Fixed corporate mTLS, TLS-verify, OAuth scope, and proxy settings being ignored in Claude Desktop sessions
Fixed managed settings that set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` not governing all signals — lower-scope signal-specific overrides no longer redirect telemetry away from the managed endpoint

title.zh-TW: 看得見、聽得清，也不會漏掉遠端的授權窗
title.en: Accessible status and no missing remote permission prompt

body.zh-TW: 使用螢幕閱讀器（把畫面文字念出來的輔助工具）時，啟動公告以前常被第一個提示畫面截斷；現在它會好好念完。思考狀態列也不再每幾秒為了更新經過時間與 token（AI 處理文字時使用的計數單位）數而重畫一次，少了反覆干擾。若有人在 Remote Control（遠端控制，讓他人連進同一工作階段）已出現授權提示後才加入，先前看不到那個待處理視窗，現在也能看見。就像會議室的廣播不再講到一半被蓋掉，晚進門的人也能看到桌上正等簽的文件。
body.en: With a screen reader (an accessibility tool that reads on-screen text aloud), the startup announcement used to be cut off by the first prompt; now it can finish. The thinking status row also stops re-rendering every few seconds merely to refresh elapsed time and token counts. In Remote Control, people who join after a permission prompt appears can now see that pending dialog. It is like a meeting-room announcement that is no longer talked over halfway through, while late arrivals can still see the document waiting for a signature.

items.original:
Fixed screen reader mode's startup announcement being cut off by the first prompt render, and the thinking status row re-rendering every few seconds to update elapsed time and token counts
Fixed Remote Control sessions not showing a pending permission prompt or dialog to viewers that connected after it appeared

title.zh-TW: 終端機的小提醒少打擾，該點的連結更好點
title.en: Fewer terminal nags, more reliable links

body.zh-TW: 透過 ssh 或 tmux 使用終端機時，footer 的 PR badge（Pull Request 徽章，連到程式碼審查頁的標記）以前因偵測不到支援而不能點；現在仍會做成可點的超連結。若你的終端機真的不想要，設 `FORCE_HYPERLINK=0` 就能關掉。登入即將到期的提醒則從五天前改為三天前，少一點太早的催促；frontend-design plugin（前端設計外掛）的推薦提示一生最多三次，不會無限重播。像桌上便利貼改成真正需要時才出現，紙上的地址也終於能直接點開。
body.en: When you use a terminal through ssh or tmux, the footer PR badge (a Pull Request marker linking to code review) could be unclickable because support could not be detected. It now stays a hyperlink; use `FORCE_HYPERLINK=0` if you truly want it off. The login-expiry warning moves from five days before expiry to three, and the frontend-design plugin suggestion appears at most three times in a lifetime instead of forever. It is like desk sticky notes appearing only when they matter, while the address written on them finally opens when clicked.

items.original:
Improved footer PR badge links to be clickable hyperlinks even when terminal support can't be detected (e.g. over ssh/tmux); set `FORCE_HYPERLINK=0` to opt out
Changed the login-expiry warning to appear 3 days before expiry instead of 5
Capped the frontend-design plugin suggestion tip at 3 lifetime impressions instead of repeating indefinitely

title.zh-TW: 子代理有上限，也不會自己無限開分身
title.en: Subagents have a ceiling and cannot endlessly branch

body.zh-TW: 一個指令若叫出太多 subagent（子代理，替主對話分頭做事的 AI 工作單位），電腦和預算都可能被拖垮。現在同時執行的子代理預設最多 20 個，可用 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS` 改上限；子代理預設也不能再繼續生子代理，真需要更深層協作才用 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` 放寬。`--max-budget-usd` 到頂時，新的背景子代理會被拒絕，已在跑的也會停下來。這像專案經理先限制同時出勤人數、禁止員工無限找下包，預算用完更會立刻收工，而非繼續記帳。
body.en: One request that launches too many subagents (AI workers that split work from the main conversation) can overwhelm both a computer and a budget. Concurrent subagents now default to a maximum of 20; change it with `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS`. Subagents also no longer create nested subagents by default; use `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` only when deeper coordination is needed. When `--max-budget-usd` is reached, new background spawns are denied and existing ones stop. It is like a project manager limiting the crew, preventing endless subcontracting, and calling work off when the budget is spent.

items.original:
Added a cap on concurrently-running subagents (default 20, override with `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS`) so one message can't fan out unbounded background agents
Changed subagents to no longer spawn nested subagents by default; set `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` to allow deeper nesting
Fixed `--max-budget-usd` not stopping background subagents: once the cap is reached, new spawns are denied and running background agents are halted

title.zh-TW: 保留網路管制，關掉檔案隔離
title.en: Keep network controls while disabling file isolation

body.zh-TW:
公司的工具若必須讀取電腦檔案，卻不能任意往外連網，現在有一道中間門。
打開設定檔——管你所有專案的 `~/.claude/settings.json`，或只管這個專案的 `.claude/settings.json`。
檔案是空的，整段貼上這個開關就好：
```
{"sandbox": {"filesystem": {"disabled": true}}}
```
檔案裡已經有設定，例如本來長這樣：
```
{
  "model": "sonnet"
}
```
就把它變成這樣：
```
{
  "model": "sonnet",
  "sandbox": {"filesystem": {"disabled": true}}
}
```
你其實只動了兩下：
1. 在原本最後一行（`"model": "sonnet"`）的結尾補一個逗號 `,`
2. 把 sandbox 那一行貼在它下面
那個逗號的意思是「還有下一個」，跟寫名單「小明、小華」中間點頓號一樣。
這樣會關掉檔案系統隔離（限制程式可看檔案範圍的防護），但保留網路出口管制。它像辦公室替指定同事打開檔案室，所有外出門仍由警衛把守；不是拆掉整套 sandbox（限制程式活動範圍的保護環境）。
body.en:
If a company tool must read files on the computer but cannot freely connect to the internet, there is now a middle gate.
Open the settings file—use `~/.claude/settings.json` to manage all your projects, or `.claude/settings.json` to manage only this project.
If the file is empty, paste in this entire switch:
```
{"sandbox": {"filesystem": {"disabled": true}}}
```
If the file already has settings, for example:
```
{
  "model": "sonnet"
}
```
change it to this:
```
{
  "model": "sonnet",
  "sandbox": {"filesystem": {"disabled": true}}
}
```
You only make two changes:
1. Add a comma `,` to the end of the original last line (`"model": "sonnet"`)
2. Paste the sandbox line below it
The comma means “another item follows,” like the comma between Alice and Bob in a list.
This turns off filesystem isolation (the safeguard that limits which files a program can see) while keeping network egress controls. It is like an office opening the file room for designated colleagues while guards still watch every exit; it does not tear down the entire sandbox (the protected environment that limits a program's range of activity).

items.original: Added `sandbox.filesystem.disabled` setting to skip filesystem isolation while keeping network egress control

title.zh-TW: 長對話與內容視窗，終於會明說卡在哪
title.en: Long chats run faster and tell you when context is full

body.zh-TW: 同一段對話談很久，Claude Code 以前會越聊越慢：每多一輪，整理訊息的成本增加得更快，續接時甚至會停好幾秒。這次修掉這種二次方累積，也讓 `/context` 在對話超過內容視窗（context window，AI 一次能記住的對話容量）時直接警告；`/compact` 壓縮失敗也會明確顯示錯誤。像桌上文件越堆越高，舊作法每加一張就得從頭翻更多遍；現在能更順地整理，抽屜塞滿時也會亮紅燈，而非假裝沒事。
body.en: A long-running chat used to get slower the longer it went: each new turn made message cleanup grow disproportionately, producing multi-second stalls and slow resumes. That quadratic buildup is fixed. `/context` now explicitly warns when the conversation exceeds its context window (how much of a conversation the AI can hold at once), and a failed `/compact` clearly appears as an error. It is like a desk where every added sheet once meant rereading a larger pile from the start; now sorting stays smoother, and an overfilled drawer shows a warning instead of pretending nothing is wrong.

items.original:
Fixed a slowdown in long sessions where message normalization cost grew quadratically with the number of turns, causing multi-second stalls and slow resumes
`/context` now shows an explicit warning when the conversation exceeds the context window, and a failed `/compact` displays as an error

title.zh-TW: 登入失效、提問與網頁續接，不再吞掉你的答案
title.en: Expired sign-ins, questions, and web resumes stop losing your answer

body.zh-TW: 你剛回答「先等等」或「先解釋」，Claude 不會再把它聽成「繼續做」；AskUserQuestion 的自由填答改為中性提示。自動模式的 OAuth token（授權令牌，證明登入身分的暫時通行證）在工作中過期或輪替，也不會被錯誤分類成 HTTP 401 而拒絕指令。網頁版閒置幾分鐘後不再重問同題、遺失回答；雲端工作階段的容器中途重啟，也會在續接時重跑被打斷的那輪，而非無回應。像客服把你的留言貼上工單，現在不會讀錯、弄丟或叫你再講一次。
body.en: If you answer “wait” or “explain first,” Claude will no longer hear it as “continue”: free-text AskUserQuestion replies now use neutral wording. When an OAuth token (a temporary pass proving your sign-in) expires or rotates mid-session, auto mode will not misclassify it as HTTP 401 and deny commands. The web app also stops asking the same question again after a few idle minutes and losing your answer. If a cloud session’s container restarts mid-turn, that interrupted turn reruns on resume rather than leaving the session unresponsive. Like a support desk, it now reads, keeps, and acts on your message without making you repeat it.

title.zh-TW: 編輯、恢復與終端機操作少了連環小故障
title.en: Editing, resuming, and terminal controls lose a chain of small failures

body.zh-TW: 改檔後用 @ 提及檔案、在 Vim 連按 `c` 指令或貼上文字，現在不會悄悄附上一片空白。工作階段恢復時，狀態列（statusline，終端機最底下顯示狀態的一行）不會跑兩次，選擇器失敗也不會卡住；背景工作很久時，閒置提示按兩下 Esc 仍能打開 `/rewind` 回溯選單。開啟 `/memory`、`/plan`、`/keybindings` 或 Ctrl+G 的圖形編輯器，也不再把滑鼠與焦點控制碼灑進終端機，`/memory` 不必等編輯器關掉才繼續。像修好的文書桌：夾子不再夾空白紙，抽屜不卡死，旁邊開著筆記本也不會把墨水潑滿桌面。
body.en: After modifying files, @-mentions, Vim’s repeated `c` operations, and pasted text no longer silently attach nothing. On resume, the statusline (the line of status at the bottom of your terminal) does not run twice, and a failed resume picker no longer hangs. In long-running work with background tasks, pressing Esc twice at an idle prompt still opens `/rewind`. Opening a GUI editor from `/memory`, `/plan`, `/keybindings`, or Ctrl+G no longer sprays mouse and focus control junk into the terminal, and `/memory` no longer waits for that editor to close. Think of a repaired desk: clips hold paper, drawers do not jam, and an open notebook beside it does not spill ink everywhere.

title.zh-TW: 背景代理與工作樹不再走錯棚
title.en: Background agents and worktrees stop wandering into the wrong set

body.zh-TW: 讓 Claude 在背景跑任務或分出工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，隔離終於守得住。恢復的背景代理會取回原本的提示詞與工具限制，不會變回預設代理；剛啟動時收到高優先訊息也不會被取消。隔離工作樹的子代理不能再靠 `git -C`、`--git-dir` 或環境變數偷偷把 Git 指去共用檢出；工作目錄選錯專案時，也不會掉進別案遺留的工作樹。沒有 Git 倉庫的背景工作樹可刪除，Ctrl+X 連按兩次能刪工作階段，死掉的背景工作者不會讓已刪項目復活。像劇組每人進自己的攝影棚：帶回自己的劇本與道具，也不能把鏡頭接到隔壁棚。
body.en: When Claude runs jobs in the background or splits work into a worktree (Git’s way to make parallel copies of one project), the isolation now holds. A resumed background agent gets back its original prompt and tool restrictions rather than reverting to the default agent, and a high-priority message during its startup window no longer cancels it. An isolated subagent cannot redirect Git into the shared checkout through `git -C`, `--git-dir`, or environment variables; a mismatched working directory also will not land in another project’s leftover worktree. Non-Git background worktrees can be deleted, Ctrl+X twice deletes a session, and a dead worker cannot resurrect it. Like a film set, each crew keeps its own stage, script, and equipment.

Fixed background sessions whose worktree has no git repository being undeletable
Fixed pressing Ctrl+X twice in the agent list failing to delete a session, and deleted sessions reappearing when their background worker had died
Fixed background subagents getting cancelled when a high-priority message arrives during their startup window

title.zh-TW: 連結、權限與指令解析，安全邊界補得更緊
title.en: Links, permissions, and command parsing get tighter safety boundaries

body.zh-TW: 專案裡看似普通的 `.claude` 捷徑檔，現在不能把 workflow 或排程工作寫到專案外；`/rewind` 也不會透過符號連結或硬連結去還原、刪除被追蹤檔案，且會告訴你跳過幾個路徑。Windows 讀取網路路徑的唯讀指令會先問權限。Bash 對非 ASCII 字元的分詞改得更接近真正 shell，PowerShell 也會驗證藏有看不見 Unicode 字元的指令；複合 Bash 指令在 `&&` 或否定式裡夾重新導向，權限檢查不再漏掉。這像保全不只看門牌，還會檢查走廊裡的暗門與偽裝字條；通往外面的門，全都先問你。
body.en: A seemingly ordinary `.claude` shortcut inside a project can no longer redirect workflow saves or scheduled-task writes outside that project. `/rewind` also will not restore or delete tracked files through symbolic or hard links, and reports how many paths it skipped. On Windows, read-only commands that access network paths now ask permission. Bash now splits non-ASCII text closer to real shell word boundaries; PowerShell validates commands with invisible Unicode characters; and permission checks no longer miss redirects inside `&&` lists or negations. It is like security checking not only the door label but hidden passages and disguised notes in the hallway — every route outside gets your approval first.

title.zh-TW: 帳號、MCP 與背景需求，重新接得回來
title.en: Accounts, MCP, and background requests reconnect cleanly

body.zh-TW: 背景工作階段沒有客戶端連著時，執行 `/mcp` 或 `/install-github-app` 不再無聲失敗，而會在代理畫面停一張「需要輸入」通知。MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）重新登入時，也不會在新登入成功前先撤銷舊憑證；背景工作階段的重新連線提示會指向能用的指令。Claude-in-Chrome 若 OAuth token 少了必要範圍，重連不再陷入 403 迴圈。最後，`claude daemon stop --any` 不會因陳舊鎖定檔誤殺無關行程。像接線員先保留舊門禁卡，直到新卡真的能刷，再把需要你回覆的便條貼在看得到的地方；也不會拿過期地址去關掉隔壁公司的機器。
body.en: If no client is attached to a background session, `/mcp` and `/install-github-app` no longer fail silently; they park a “needs input” request in the agent view. During MCP reauthentication (Model Context Protocol, the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools), working credentials are not revoked until the new sign-in succeeds, and its background reconnect message points to a usable command. Claude-in-Chrome no longer loops on 403 reconnects when an OAuth token lacks a required scope. Finally, `claude daemon stop --any` will not kill an unrelated process because of a stale legacy lockfile. Like a receptionist, it keeps the old access card until the new one works and leaves your note where you can see it.

title.zh-TW: 畫面、選單與診斷訊息，更不會讓人猜

Like an airport board, it no longer cuts off the useful part of the message.

title.zh-TW: 權限紀錄與圖表建議，少了誤判
title.en: Permission reporting and chart guidance stop mislabeling events

body.zh-TW: 使用者拒絕權限、取消工作，現在在 telemetry（遙測，回傳產品使用狀態的紀錄）裡會被正確分開：跳出權限詢問卻失敗的請求，不再算成你拒絕；你主動中斷則標為使用者中止。PowerShell 裡 `git`、`gh` 的參數驗證也更嚴謹。隨附的 dataviz skill（資料視覺化指引）則調整預設圖表色盤順序，並修正四條資料線也建議直接標籤的說法。這像客服報表終於把「櫃台故障」「客人離開」和「客人拒絕」分成不同欄，不會把錯怪到你頭上；儀表板也換了更好辨認的顏色安排。

Think of two measuring tools in a toolbox: it used to pull them out on its own; now you hold the handle. Call for one when needed, and it will not add an unasked-for check to your work.

title.zh-TW: 追查一段工作，記錄終於接得起來
title.en: Logs now connect the pieces of one job

body.zh-TW: 當你想查「這則訊息到底叫了哪個工具、花了多少資源」，紀錄不該像散落的收據。memory 檔案（讓 Claude 留下跨工作階段筆記的檔案）現在有 ISO `modified` 時間戳；OpenTelemetry（把程式執行紀錄送進監控工具的標準）則替每則訊息加上 UUID、請求編號和工具來源，也可設定內容欄位原本 60 KB 的截斷上限。自訂 agent 列表能顯示模型與 reasoning effort（推理投入程度）。串流重複送出的累積訊息不會再把成本和 token（模型處理文字的計量單位）重複算，非同步紀錄也會帶上正確追蹤脈絡。最後，memory 裡行內 `#` 不會再害後面內容被截掉。像把每張收據編號、蓋章、釘回同一份帳本。
body.en: Tracing one job should not mean sorting scattered receipts. Memory files now carry an ISO `modified` timestamp, while OpenTelemetry events get message IDs, request IDs, and tool provenance, with a configurable 60 KB content limit. Custom agent rows can show model and reasoning effort; streaming telemetry no longer double-counts costs or tokens, and async logs retain trace context. Inline `#` no longer chops off saved memory values. It is a ledger where every receipt is numbered and filed together.

Fixed session cost and token telemetry double-counting on streams that emit multiple cumulative `message_delta` frames
Fixed OTel log events emitted outside the turn's async context missing the interaction span's trace context

title.zh-TW: Windows 終端機少了卡死與亂碼
title.en: Windows terminal work loses its hangs and garbling

body.zh-TW: 你在 Windows 用 PowerShell 跑工具，子程序等著標準輸入時，過去可能一路卡到逾時；現在能正常收尾。Python 讀到非 UTF-8 資料，或輸出非 ASCII 字元，也不會因編碼錯誤崩掉；PowerShell 7 的錯誤訊息不再夾著 ANSI escape sequence（控制終端機顏色等格式的隱藏碼）。`where.exe`、`fc.exe` 和 `diff.exe` 回報「沒找到差異」這類正常否定答案，也不會被誤報成錯誤。最後，Windows PowerShell 5.1 的 `>`、`>>` 會寫出其他工具讀得懂的 UTF-8，而非 UTF-16LE。像同一條傳送帶終於統一箱子標籤，既不塞車也不讀錯字。
body.en: On Windows, PowerShell commands no longer wait until timeout when a child process needs standard input. Python now survives non-UTF-8 input and non-ASCII output, PowerShell 7 errors lose their raw terminal control codes, and valid “not found” answers from `where.exe`, `fc.exe`, and `diff.exe` are not treated as failures. PowerShell 5.1 redirects now write UTF-8 instead of UTF-16LE. It is one conveyor belt with labels every tool can read.

title.zh-TW: 背景工作不再佔著位子又刪不掉
title.en: Background work no longer lingers or becomes undeletable

body.zh-TW: 把工作放到 background 工作階段（背景執行，不佔著你眼前終端機）後，最煩的是它明明停了卻還佔著資源，或想清掉卻找不到。這版修了整條收尾流程：舊 daemon（背景常駐程式）退場時不會刪掉接班者的 control socket（用來溝通的本機通道）；用 `←` 或 `/background` 暫停的工作不會無限養著 worker；服務閒置、從非 Git 資料夾送出、或重新開啟時遇到不可讀目錄，都不會讓刪除或還原對話失敗。像夜班交接不再把新值班員的鑰匙丟掉，完成的工作階段也能確實清掉。
body.en: Background work should not keep a desk forever or become impossible to remove. A departing daemon no longer deletes its successor’s control socket; parked jobs no longer keep workers alive indefinitely; and deletion or restore no longer breaks because the service is idle, work came from outside Git, or the session store has an unreadable folder. Like a night shift that hands over the right keys, every finished session can be removed cleanly.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制與設定頁，不再無故被擋住

In agent view, `/install-github-app` and `/mcp` settings are available unless a background session has no terminal attached. Plugins enabled with `--settings` load again, and long-running sessions refresh feature flags after an OAuth token rotates. It is a remote control that responds only to paired devices, with settings blocked only when a background session has no terminal attached.

title.zh-TW: MCP 服務與連線，暫時出錯不會整排消失
title.en: MCP services and connections survive temporary errors

body.zh-TW: 當你更新 MCP（讓 Claude 連接外部工具的協定）的提示與資源時，偶發錯誤不再把伺服器現有的斜線指令和資源清空，像工具箱短暫斷電，裡面的工具仍留在原位。hooks（特定事件發生時自動執行的指令）傳回 exit code 2 而 stdout JSON 未通過 schema validation（檢查資料格式是否合規）時，現在仍會如文件所說阻擋。`/ultrareview` 在沒有 merge base（兩條 Git 分支共同起點）的 Git repository 裡，不再拒絕執行，會提供審查所有 tracked files（Git 正在追蹤的檔案）。若 keep-alive connection pooling（重複使用連線的方式）遇到 stale-connection error，之後會停用它，重試改開新 socket（網路連線通道）。
body.en: A transient error while refreshing MCP prompts and resources no longer clears a server's existing slash commands and resources, like a brief power flicker that leaves tools in their box. Hooks returning exit code 2 still block as documented when their stdout JSON fails schema validation. `/ultrareview` no longer refuses to run in a Git repository with no merge base: it offers to review all tracked files. After a stale-connection error, keep-alive connection pooling is disabled so retries open a fresh socket.

title.zh-TW: 對話分身自動掛名，跑腿小幫手分家
title.en: Conversation copies name themselves, and the helper gets its own lane

body.zh-TW: 你請 Claude 改報告磨了半小時，它摸熟你的想法了，這時又想順便生一版簡報。插話問，討論會變大雜燴；開新對話，它又什麼都不記得，得重講半小時。這正是打「/fork」的時刻（原意是叉子，因為它像樹枝分岔，從目前對話分出一條新枝）。打下去，Claude 把聊到現在的內容整份複製給分身，成為獨立的「背景工作階段」（background session，丟到背景自己繼續跑、不用你盯著），帶著全部記憶去做簡報；你留在原地改報告。分身就像交出去的外送單：在「claude agents」清單自成一列，沒取名字就自動拿你交代的那句話當名字，一眼認出誰是誰。「查一下這個詞」這種要等答案才能繼續的小事，交給「/subtask」（子任務）。它是原本「/fork」順便叫出的內建子代理（subagent），這次分了家——就像外送平台把「叫外送」跟「請店內夥計跑腿」分成兩顆按鈕，你再也不會按錯。
body.en: You have spent half an hour revising a report with Claude, and it now understands your thinking. Then you want it to make a slide deck too. Ask in the same conversation and the discussion becomes a jumble; start a new one and Claude remembers nothing, so you must explain it all again for half an hour. That is when to use `/fork`: named after a fork in a tree, it branches off from the current conversation. Run it and Claude gives a copy everything discussed so far as an independent background session, which makes the slide deck with all that context while you keep revising the report. The copy is like a delivery order you hand off: it gets its own row in `claude agents`, and if unnamed, takes your prompt as its name so you can tell them apart. For a small job such as “look up this term,” where you need the answer before continuing, use `/subtask`. It is the built-in subagent that `/fork` used to launch along the way, but they now have separate homes—like a delivery app splitting “order delivery” and “ask the shop assistant to run an errand” into two buttons, so you no longer press the wrong one.

title.zh-TW: 刪掉的對話找得回來，分身做完會回報
title.en: Deleted sessions can come back, and copies report when they're done

body.zh-TW: 派出去的分身，現在更難搞丟、也更會回報。昨天手滑刪掉的對話，今天又想接著用？在代理畫面輸入「/resume」（恢復），過去的工作階段都會列出來讓你挑——連從清單手動刪掉的都找得回來，選了就丟回背景接著跑，像取消的外送單還能重新派送。兩個會讓分身出狀況的毛病修好了：以前分身碰上寫入失敗，會失去跟主線對話的保護；剛停掉的分身重開，偶爾也不吭聲就失敗——現在重開要嘛直接成功，要嘛講清楚原因、讓你強制重開。你中途點開一個還在開機的分身，也不再對著空白畫面乾等，會先看到整理好的對話紀錄。分身做完事而你正閒著時，左下角提示字會跳「N done」（N 件完成）閃一下提醒你。就像每位外送員送達都會回報，你不用一直開門張望。

Type `/resume` in the agent view and you can choose from past sessions — including ones manually removed from the list — then send it back to the background to keep running, like re-dispatching a cancelled delivery order. Two bugs that could disrupt a copy are fixed: after a state write failure, it used to lose its protection tied to the parent conversation; reopening a just-stopped copy also sometimes failed without a word. Now reopening either succeeds or explains why it cannot and lets you force a restart. Open a copy that is still booting and, instead of staring at a blank screen, you first see the formatted transcript. When a copy finishes while you have nothing to answer, the footer briefly pulses `N done` to alert you. Like every courier reporting a delivery, you no longer need to keep watching the door.

body.zh-TW: 你是否曾遇過自動模式（auto-mode）失控？當 Claude 陷入瘋狂搜尋或無限開啟子代理（subagent）的迴圈時，荷包可能瞬間大失血。現在系統加裝了跳電保護。單一工作階段（session）的網頁搜尋與子代理數量預設限制在 200 次，一旦超標就強制中斷，打「/clear」可重新計數。如果遇上運行超過 2 分鐘的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）指令，也會自動移到背景執行，不讓畫面卡死。若要回復乾淨的預設值，這正是你輸入「claude auto-mode reset」的時刻，系統會先詢問確認，加上「--yes」就能直接跳過。像家裡裝了無熔絲開關，一個插座短路只會跳開它，不會燒毀整棟房子。
body.en: Have you ever watched auto-mode run wild? When Claude spirals into endless searches or subagent loops, your budget can vanish instantly. Now there is a breaker in place. A session is capped at 200 WebSearch calls and 200 subagent spawns by default, with `/clear` resetting the counter. Any MCP (Model Context Protocol) call running past 2 minutes automatically moves to the background so your window does not freeze. If you want to wipe the slate clean, that is when to run `claude auto-mode reset` (adding `--yes` skips the confirmation prompt). It is like adding a surge protector to your home—a single faulty plug trips the switch instead of burning down the house.

title.zh-TW: 危險指令與掛鉤失效的漏洞補齊
title.en: Holes that let risky commands slip through without asking are patched

When you create a worktree (Git's feature for parallel copies), Claude will no longer write files outside your folder by following a symlink (a shortcut file pointing elsewhere). In addition, when a hook (a script triggered by events) requests a halt, infrastructure errors will no longer swallow the command. Even if a process receives SIGTERM, the CLI kills the whole process tree. It is like a security system patching unlocked back doors—what should be blocked actually is.

title.zh-TW: 終端機操作卡頓與跑版修好了

Keyboards with extended reporting can now use Ctrl+J for newlines correctly. title.zh-TW: 遙測回報與搜尋擷取的可靠度修好了

OpenTelemetry HTTP exports to Azure Monitor will use compatible settings to avoid chunked transfer rejections. Under headless mode (running without terminal windows), OTLP logs will not lose trace IDs when TRACEPARENT is set. If web search hits an overloaded server or rate limits, the tool now retries with backoff instead of giving up with an API error text. It is like an agent waiting for a line to clear and calling back later, instead of reporting a busy signal as the final answer.

title.zh-TW: 換模型與傳訊更即時，講話變輕量

body.zh-TW: 呼叫 AI 總是花大把冤枉錢，而且中途換模型還要等下一輪才生效？這批更新讓傳送指令更即時且省錢。現在提示詞快取（prompt caching，把重複提問暫存以節省成本的功能）在 Bedrock 或自訂代理端點也終於支援了。當多個代理互相對話時，訊息本體不會在歷史紀錄中重複塞兩次，節省你的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）花費。在無頭模式下，當你想切換模型，這正是打「set_model」的時刻，指令會直接在下個往返當下生效。像外送軟體分清「正在送餐」與「等你確認付款」，狀態會顯示「需要輸入」，再也不會讓你乾等。
body.en: Are you spending too much on AI tokens, or waiting until the next turn just to switch models? We have made communications faster and lighter. Prompt caching (saving past prompts to reduce costs) now works across gateways like Bedrock or custom base URLs. In multi-agent systems, messages are no longer duplicated in histories, saving your token budget. Under headless mode, when you need to swap models, that is when to send a `set_model` request, which changes the model on the spot instead of waiting for the next turn. It is like a delivery app distinguishing between "out for delivery" and "waiting for approval," so you are never left guessing.

title.en: Parallel sessions stay logged in and MCP servers auto-reconnect

body.zh-TW: 早上打開電腦重啟工作，卻發現開著的對話視窗集體被登出，或背景工具全部斷線？這些睡眠喚醒後的疑難雜症已全被修好。以往多個工作階段（session，工作階段為原定譯法）睡眠喚醒後會連鎖登出，現已隔離。同時多個工作階段共用同一個憑證庫（credential store，存登入證明的地方）也不會互相干擾。閒置對話喚醒後，外部工具伺服器（MCP servers）也會自動重新連線。而在 Windows 的無畫面工作階段下，也不會再因為讀不到鍵盤輸入就直接崩潰。就像員工睡醒回到崗位，櫃檯不會弄丟認證，外部合作商的電話也重新接通。
body.en: Are you tired of finding your terminal windows logged out or plugins disconnected after your computer wakes from sleep? The sleep-wake recovery bugs are now solved. Sessions sharing one credential store (where logins are saved) will not trigger simultaneous logouts when waking up. In addition, idle web sessions will now auto-reconnect to MCP servers (tool integration servers) right away. Background jobs using LLM gateway tokens stay authorized when the daemon restarts, and Windows headless processes will not crash if stdin goes dry. It is like staff returning to their desks—IDs are intact and partner phones reconnect.

items.original:
Fixed parallel Claude Code sessions all logging out simultaneously after wake-from-sleep when many sessions share one credential store
Fixed plugin MCP servers not reconnecting after an idle web session woke, leaving MCP calls failing until the next message
Fixed background jobs on LLM gateway auth (`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` + `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) coming back "Not logged in" after the daemon respawns them
Fixed headless print-mode sessions on Windows crashing or silently exiting when stdin is unreadable
Hardened synced skill/plugin directory naming on Windows and kept CCR web fetch/search proxies working after `/clear`

title.zh-TW: 介面反應變快，小毛病不再煩人
title.en: Async panel delays and odd UI bugs fixed

body.zh-TW: 頻繁切換設定分頁或清除對話時，是否覺得畫面載入總是慢半拍？多個拖慢速度的介面問題已被一掃而空。非同步內容載入時原本存在 300 毫秒的延遲，現在已被完全抹平，畫面渲染效能也大幅提升。以前在輸入框輸入問號「?」時指令會被吃掉，現在這異常現象已修正。此外，當你以「/clear」清除當前的工作階段（session，工作階段為原定譯法）時，一切將重新計量。顯示在最底下的狀態列（statusLine，狀態列為原定譯法）費用計算也會確實歸零。就像開車的儀表板，以前切換功能會卡頓，現在指針反應靈敏，且按重設時里程表會乖乖歸零。
body.en: Does switching panels or running `/clear` feel a bit sluggish? This update sweeps away UI lags and annoying quirks. The 300ms delay before loading Settings and Stats views is gone, and terminal rendering is faster. Entering a single question mark in the command prompt will not open the shortcuts panel by mistake anymore. When you run `/clear` to reset the current session, the cost counter will start fresh. The statusline (the bar showing info at the bottom) also resets to $0. It is like a dashboard where shifting screens is instant, and resetting your trip meter actually resets it to zero.

Fixed `/clear` not resetting the session cost counter — the statusline's cost now starts at $0 after `/clear`

title.zh-TW: 計費精準不亂算，模型載入更聰明
title.en: Precision token billing and smarter memory indexing

body.zh-TW: 擔心因為快取失效而被重複收取重複提問的運算費嗎？這批修復讓計費更精準，避免花冤枉錢。在 Bedrock 與 Vertex 雲端服務上，提示詞快取（prompt-caching，把重複提問暫存以節省成本的功能）的退化問題已解決，不會再把背景系統脈絡誤算為新文字。現在若遇到模型備援（fallback，備援為原定譯法）警報，系統也會依照你的設定，在載入時自動修正，不跳多餘的警示。就像去市場買菜的過磅機，只精確秤量你買的菜，不把額外包裝袋也算進重量多收錢。
body.en: Want to save on recurring tokens but worried that cache slips are costing you extra? We have patched credit calculations to prevent double billing. Prompt caching (saving past prompts to lower token use) on Bedrock or Vertex will no longer bill the trailing system block as fresh inputs on every request. If repository models are configured explicitly, Claude won't trigger default configurations or spurious fallback alerts at startup. It is like a produce scale that only weighs the vegetables you buy, without charging you for the heavy plastic wrapping.

title.zh-TW: 畫面不卡死、任務不迷路，介面操作更順手
title.en: Interface stays smooth and tasks don't get lost

body.zh-TW: 現在你看著終端機（terminal，輸入指令的黑畫面）等系統跑長時間任務時，不再只能盯著靜止畫面發呆，而且在各個任務間切換也更穩定了。以前當它在背後執行很耗時的工具指令時，進度條看起來就像當機一樣不動；現在工具摘要欄位會有一秒一秒跳動的計時器，讓你知道它還在努力。同時，代理（agent，幫你自動做事的 AI 分身）清單底部的提示現在會明確顯示有幾個背景對話（background sessions，在主畫面背後默默執行的工作）正在等你回覆，數字改變時還會用顏色閃爍提醒；而且按左方向鍵（←）打開 agents 總覽畫面後，如果你切回原本的對話，先前的任務追蹤列表也不會再消失或讓畫面殘留疊影了。另外，重新接上背景對話的指令（`claude attach`）現在會耐心等系統準備好再連線，不會因為太心急而跳出「找不到工作」的錯誤。對使用螢幕報讀器的使用者來說，按 Shift+Tab 切換權限模式時，系統現在也會大聲把新模式唸出來了。就像你去銀行辦事，以前抽完號碼牌只能看著停滯的看板乾等，還以為機器壞了；現在看板會清楚跳秒數、輪到你時會閃燈提醒，而且就算你去別的櫃檯轉一圈回來，你的進度也妥妥地留在看板上。
body.en: When you're watching the terminal (the black screen where you type commands) wait for long-running tasks, you no longer have to stare at a frozen screen, and switching between tasks is much more stable. Previously, when it ran a time-consuming tool command behind the scenes, the progress bar looked stuck; now the tool summary line features a live, ticking elapsed-time counter so you know it's still working. Meanwhile, the footer hint at the bottom of your agent list (agents are AI assistants that do work for you) clearly shows how many background sessions (tasks running silently behind the main screen) are waiting for your reply, briefly flashing with color when the count changes. Also, pressing the left arrow (←) to open the agents view and then returning to the original session won't cause the task tracker to vanish or leave overlapping ghost frames on your screen anymore. Furthermore, the `claude attach` command (used to reconnect to a background session) now patiently waits for the system to settle before connecting, instead of impatiently throwing a "job not found" error. For screen reader users, pressing Shift+Tab to cycle through permission modes now announces the new mode aloud. It's like taking a number at a bank: you used to stare at a frozen digital display wondering if the machine broke, but now the screen ticks the seconds clearly, flashes when it's your turn, and even if you step away to another counter and come back, your place in line is still securely on the board.

title.zh-TW: 關閉任務不留垃圾，編輯與貼上更乾淨乾脆
title.en: Closing tasks leaves no trash, and copy-pasting is much cleaner

body.zh-TW: 當你刪除任務或貼上文字時，系統不會再悄悄留下讓你困擾的「殘留物」了。以前，如果你強制殺掉一個背景任務，它可能會在你的版本控制系統裡留下一個永久的工作樹鎖定（git worktree lock，防止別的 process 同時搶用同一個 worktree 的管理鎖），害你之後怎麼都無法操作 Git；現在系統懂得定期巡邏，把那些主人已經死掉的鎖清乾淨。另外，當你把 Claude 裡的文字貼到外部編輯器時，也不會再莫名其妙黏著 `È` 或 `É` 這種奇怪的亂碼。如果外掛程式寫入快取（cache，暫存資料的地方）失敗，現在也不會留下一堆無用的暫存檔，並且修好了在 Windows 系統上容易撞到的檔案重新命名錯誤。在介面上，被你刪掉的對話，它原本夾帶的圖片不會再像陰魂不散一樣卡在儀表板上；而且當你直接同意一個計畫而沒有做任何修改時，系統也不會再錯誤標記「使用者已編輯」，更不會拿舊的版本把你的計畫檔覆蓋掉。就像你去飯店退房，以前房客離開後可能還把保險箱鎖死，或者在牆上留下撕不掉的膠帶殘膠；現在房務員會把保險箱解鎖、殘膠清乾淨，保證下一個客人住進來時一塵不染。
body.en: When you delete tasks or paste text, the system will no longer quietly leave behind annoying residues. Previously, if you force-killed a background session, it might leave a permanent git worktree lock (an administrative lock preventing other processes from concurrently using the same worktree) in your version control system, completely blocking your Git commands forever; now, the system regularly sweeps the area to release locks whose owning processes have died. Also, when you paste text from Claude into an external editor, it won't inexplicably come attached with weird garbage characters like `È` or `É` anymore. If a plugin fails to write to its cache (a place for temporary data), it will no longer leave behind useless temporary files, and a tricky locked-file rename error that plagued Windows users has been fixed. Visually, images pasted into abandoned reply drafts won't stubbornly haunt your agents dashboard after the session is deleted; and when you approve a plan without making any changes, the system won't falsely brand it "(edited by user)" or overwrite your plan file with a stale snapshot. It's like checking out of a hotel: a previous guest might have left the safe locked or left stubborn tape residue on the walls, but now the housekeeping staff unlocks the safe and scrubs the glue away, ensuring the room is completely spotless for the next guest.

title.zh-TW: AI 不再對指令產生幻覺，讀檔與紀錄更精準
title.en: AI no longer hallucinates command results, improving file reading and logging

body.zh-TW: Claude 判斷執行狀態的腦袋變得更精明，不會再誤判指令的結果或偷偷略過資料了。以前如果它下了一個切換資料夾（`cd`）的指令但因為太耗時被移到背景執行，它會產生幻覺以為自己已經在新資料夾裡了；現在系統會明確告訴它「工作目錄並沒有改變」。同樣地，當終端機指令超時被自動放到背景時，系統給的訊息也變得更清楚，讓 AI 能分辨「這是當機卡住了」還是「只是被放到背景」。此外，如果你的自訂技能（skills）或指令裡有用來佔位的變數（像是 `$1` 或 `$2`），以前會被系統當成廢話默默吃掉，現在則會一字不漏地保留。而當它寫入記憶檔（MEMORY.md，Claude 用來記住重要事項的筆記本）的內容超過讀取上限時，以前它會悄悄把超出的部分截斷，讓你以為全都記下了；現在它會直接大聲報錯，逼著整理。甚至連搜尋檔案內容（Grep）翻頁翻到底時，也不會再傻傻地回報「找不到相符結果」了。另外，鉤子（hook，在特定事件發生時自動觸發的程式）超時的時候不會再錯誤地回報為「使用者拒絕」，害它中途停下來傻等；內建的資料視覺化技能，它的圖表顏色也換成了對色盲更友善的科學色碼標準。就像你請助理去圖書館找資料，以前他找時間太久被你叫回來，還會幻想自己已經把書借出來了，或者筆記本寫滿了就偷偷把後面的內容撕掉；現在他會老實報告還沒借到書，而且筆記本一滿就會立刻舉手跟你換一本新的。
body.en: Claude's brain for tracking execution states has gotten sharper, so it won't misjudge command results or quietly ignore data anymore. Previously, if it issued a change directory (`cd`) command that took too long and got shunted to the background, it would hallucinate that it was already inside the new folder; the system now explicitly tells it that the working directory is unchanged. Similarly, when a terminal command times out and is auto-backgrounded, the message given to the AI is much clearer, helping it distinguish whether the command is hopelessly hung or merely running in the background. Moreover, if your custom skills or commands use positional placeholders (like `$1` or `$2`), the system used to treat them as garbage and silently devour them; they are now preserved exactly as written. When writing to the memory file (MEMORY.md, Claude's notebook for remembering important things) pushes the index past its read limit, it used to quietly truncate the overflowing parts leaving you thinking everything was saved; now it throws a loud, explicit error to force a cleanup. Even Grep (the tool for searching inside files) will no longer foolishly claim "No matches found" when you simply paginate past the end of the results. Also, when a hook (a script triggered by specific events) times out, it won't be falsely reported as a user rejection that freezes unattended sessions, and the bundled data visualization skill now uses scientifically calibrated color codes that are much friendlier to colorblind users. It's like sending an assistant to the library: previously, if you called him back because he took too long, he'd hallucinate that he had already checked the books out, or if his notebook was full he'd just rip up the remaining pages; now, he honestly reports he hasn't gotten the books yet, and the moment his notebook fills up, he immediately raises his hand to ask for a new one.

title.zh-TW: 分身代理不越界，安全防護與連線更牢固
title.en: Subagents stay in bounds with hardened security and robust connections

body.zh-TW: 你現在叫出的分身代理更守規矩了，不用擔心它們亂跑，而且抵禦外在惡意內容的防護網也變厚了。以前，當你設定代理在獨立的工作樹（worktree，像是專案的平行時空副本）裡隔離作業時，它竟然還能跑去修改你最主線的程式碼；現在它被嚴格限制，只能在自己的沙盒裡玩沙，絕不能動到主程式。我們也強化了代理的抵抗力，防止它在讀取網頁或檔案時，被裡面暗藏的惡意提示詞（prompt injection，駭客把偷渡指令寫在文章裡騙 AI 執行的手法）牽著鼻子走。另外，用來加開更高強度處理效果的 `ultracode` 關鍵字，以前只要網頁鉤子（webhook）或 GitHub 留言裡剛好提到這個詞就會被誤觸，現在只有人類親手輸入才會生效；同時也修好了在終端機指令裡指定 `--effort ultracode` 卻被偷偷忽略的問題。針對開發者，外掛提供的 MCP 伺服器（讓 AI 能接上外部工具的橋樑）不會再因為中途重新同步而被無辜拆除了；透過初始化請求註冊的 SDK MCP 伺服器，也不會再傻傻等到下一輪才開始連線。此外，Fable 顧問模型因為伺服器問題暫時從選擇器裡移除了，等修好就會回來。就像公司請了臨時工來幫忙，以前他們會不小心跑到總經理辦公室亂改文件，還會聽信路邊撿到的紙條亂做事；現在他們都被配發了專屬的封閉工作間，而且受過反詐騙訓練，只聽從你親自下達的指令。
body.en: The subagents you spawn are now much better behaved, saving you from worrying about them going rogue, and the defensive net against external malicious content is thicker. Previously, when you configured an agent to work isolated inside its own worktree (a feature acting like a parallel universe copy of your project), it could somehow still reach out and run git-mutating commands on your main repository checkout; it's now strictly confined to playing in its own sandbox and cannot touch the main codebase. We've also hardened the agent's immune system to prevent it from being manipulated by indirect prompt injection (a trick where hackers hide sneaky commands inside articles to trick the AI) when it reads web pages or files. Additionally, the `ultracode` keyword used to opt into higher-effort processing used to accidentally trigger if a webhook payload or a GitHub comment merely mentioned the word; it now only activates when explicitly typed by a human. The bug where specifying `--effort ultracode` in terminal commands was silently ignored has also been fixed. For developers, plugin-provided MCP servers (bridges that let AI connect to external tools) will no longer be unfairly torn down if they resync mid-session; and SDK MCP servers registered via an initialize request won't foolishly wait until the next turn to start connecting. Also, the Fable advisor model has been temporarily removed from the picker while a server-side issue is being patched. It's like hiring temporary workers to help out: previously, they might accidentally wander into the CEO's office to alter documents or blindly follow instructions found on a scrap of paper in the street; now, they are assigned dedicated, locked workspaces and have been given anti-fraud training so they only listen to your direct orders.

title.zh-TW: 啟動防呆更完善，當機風險與設定衝突大幅降低
title.en: Smarter startup checks drastically reduce crashes and config conflicts

body.zh-TW: 現在你不必再擔心設定錯誤或連線不穩會讓整個程式崩潰了。現在當你在設定檔裡寫錯權限規則（例如用了 `Write`、`NotebookEdit` 或 `Glob`），啟動時就會發出警告，提醒你改用更精確的 `Edit` 或 `Read`。對於使用企業雲端通道（如 Bedrock 或 Vertex）的人，因為自動模式現在預設就開著，`/doctor` 指令（幫你檢查系統環境的醫生）不會再多此一舉叫你去開啟它；同時外部對話的權限分類器也預設升級成更聰明的 Sonnet 5 模型來把關。在安全性上，後來才冒出來的隱藏捷徑（symlinks）現在也會被確實擋下，確保它們能被正確納入沙盒的「禁止寫入清單」中。我們還修復了三個會讓你嚇一跳的崩潰問題：一個是當工具回傳了系統看不懂的純數字時造成的崩潰；一個是當介面元件發生錯誤時，殘留的文字碎片不小心跟著當機報告（telemetry）回傳的問題；最後一個是當你重新連線時，背景小幫手陷入無限重新啟動的死亡迴圈。這就像是一輛裝了新一代防護系統的車子，以前你加錯油箱或保險絲燒掉它就直接拋錨在路中央；現在它會在引擎發動前先亮警告燈提醒你，而且就算導航系統突然斷線，它也能穩穩地在背景繼續運作，不會整輛車失控打轉。
body.en: You no longer have to worry about misconfigurations or unstable connections crashing the entire program. Now, if you mistakenly use permission rules like `Write`, `NotebookEdit`, or `Glob` in your configuration file, a warning will be issued right at startup, suggesting you use the more precise `Edit` or `Read` rules instead. For those using enterprise cloud channels (like Bedrock or Vertex) where auto mode is now enabled by default, the `/doctor` command (a diagnostic tool that checks your system health) will no longer redundantly suggest you opt-in; meanwhile, the permission classifier for external sessions has been upgraded by default to the smarter Sonnet 5 model to stand guard. On the security front, late-appearing symlinks (hidden shortcut links) will now be properly blocked by the sandbox to ensure they are properly reconciled into the sandbox deny-write list. We've also fixed three startling crash scenarios: one where a tool returning a plain number that the system couldn't parse caused a session crash; another where a stray text fragment accidentally leaked into crash telemetry reports when a UI component errored out; and a final one where a client resetting its connection threw background workers into an infinite crash-loop of death. It's like a car equipped with a next-gen safety system: previously, if you put the wrong gas in or a fuse blew, it would just break down in the middle of the highway; now, it flashes a warning light on the dashboard before you even start the engine, and even if the GPS suddenly disconnects, it keeps driving steadily in the background without spinning out of control.

items.original:
Added a startup warning for `Write(path)`, `NotebookEdit(path)`, and `Glob(path)` permission rules — use `Edit(path)` or `Read(path)` instead
Fixed a rendered text fragment leaking into crash telemetry when a UI component returned content outside a styled text element
Fixed a session crash when a tool's result renderer returned a numeric bigint value or plain text instead of a UI element
Fixed `/doctor` skipping its auto-mode-default proposal on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, where auto mode no longer needs an opt-in
Fixed background workers crash-looping when a client resets its connection to the background service
Fixed late-appearing `.claude/*` symlinks not being reconciled into the sandbox deny-write list
Improved auto mode: the permission classifier now defaults to Sonnet 5 for external sessions, validated on the session's first request and pinned for the session

entries: Fixed /model and other dialogs being blocked in `claude agents` background sessions (reverts an overly broad guard)

title.zh-TW: 背景任務不再擋選單，互動指令恢復正常
title.en: Interactive menus are no longer blocked in agent background sessions

body.zh-TW: 現在你在跑代理的背景任務時，又可以順暢使用切換模型等互動選單，不會再被莫名擋下。以前，一個設定得太嚴格的防護機制（guard，用來阻擋非預期操作的保安設定）不小心封殺了 `/model` 指令與其他對話框，導致你在跑 `claude agents`（Claude 同時開多個分身代理幫你做事的功能）背景任務（background sessions，在主畫面背後默默執行的工作）時無法叫出這些互動介面。現在這個管太寬的限制已經被撤銷，讓你恢復應有的操作權限。就像辦公室換了新的電子鎖，結果設定太嚴格，連正常上班的員工都被鎖在自己的會議室外面；現在門禁規定撤回原本的標準，你總算能正常推開門辦公了。
body.en: You can once again use interactive menus, like changing AI models, without them getting stuck while running agent tasks behind the scenes. Previously, an overly strict guard (a protective mechanism meant to prevent unwanted actions) accidentally blocked the `/model` command and other dialogs from appearing in `claude agents` (a feature where Claude opens multiple agent instances to work for you) background sessions (tasks running silently in the background). This meant you couldn't interact with these interfaces when you needed to. We've rolled back this overly broad restriction so everything works normally again. It's like an office security door that was set so strictly it locked regular employees out of their own meeting rooms; the rule has been reverted to its standard setting so you can actually push the door open and get to work.
